description: Create a new application from a GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository

auto_deploy_on_push.description: Redeploy automatically on every push to the deployed branch

container_port.description: Port the container listens on (container apps)

deployment_type.description: Deployment type: 'static' for static sites, 'container' for server applications

framework.description: The framework id, validated by the backend registry. Common values: react, nextjs, nuxt, sveltekit, remix, astro, vue, angular, svelte, express, fastify, nestjs, django, flask, fastapi, gin, springboot, rails, laravel, html

git_provider.description: Force the git provider; needed for self-hosted GitLab where the URL host is not gitlab.com

github_branch.description: The branch to deploy from (defaults to main/master)

github_repo_url.description: The repository URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo, https://gitlab.com/group/project, https://bitbucket.org/workspace/repo). The provider is inferred from the host.

gitlab_project_id.description: GitLab project id or full path (self-hosted GitLab)

min_instances.description: Minimum running instances; 0 scales to zero when idle (container apps)

name.description: The name for the new application

organisation_id.description: The organization ID to create the application in

password.description: Visitor password to gate the site behind from the first deploy (6-128 characters). Omit for a public site.

root_directory.description: Repo-relative folder to build from, for monorepos (e.g., 'apps/web')

name: create-application
